PPG-5-Ceteth-20 (10) and PEG-55 Propylene Glycol Oleate (11) are not routes (C3). Counter-signals toward low (Soybean Oil 6, Dicaprylyl Ether 13, cationic polymers) recorded but cannot move the C1 value; the realistic unknown is the single buffer's level -> neighbor strong.

Counter-signal: no silicone, polymers sit after salt/pH adjusters (likely low level), liquid oil -> neighbor moderate.

weightPotential.counterEvidence: W-RICH is formally met (prominent payload lipid converging with cationic deposition), pulling toward high.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Lipid plus two cationic polymers plausibly leave noticeable but bounded residue; sulfate reset and the absence of silicone/waxy lipid bound it.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: the high anchor needs multiple persistent systems or a rich architecture with limited reset; here reset is a normal SLES chassis, the lipid is a liquid oil, the polymers are listed after salt/NaOH and there is no silicone. Not low: W-RICH and two cationic polymers make 'lightweight' an understatement (W2).
weightPotential.limitingFactor: W-RICH present with moderate reset: realistic unknowns (oil level) could move it to high.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate (depositionLoad moderate, persistence moderate, resetCapacity moderate); neighbor high.
weightPotential.selfCheck: Fingerprint matches; blind formula judgment; no count/position assigned band; three subjudgments present; whyNotNeighborBand specific; no in-lane comparison.
